plugins.name: rtl-code
plugins.description: RTL Code: Hebrew reads right to left in the Claude Code terminal. /rtl or a footer button turns it on: Hebrew lines flush right with their markdown kept, a live mirrored preview of a Hebrew draft above the prompt, your own Hebrew messages marked, Hebrew copied off the terminal pasted in reading order, and Claude told how to write mixed Hebrew/English.
